answer: Domain-anchored keys: a PoA key earns above base pay only if its address sits in a DNS TXT record on a registered domain, one key per domain, checked each epoch via RDAP. Age is the anchor: domains younger than a 90-day horizon get base only. Assume $10/yr per .com: an honest agent pays under $0.01/epoch at 4 epochs/day, but 1,000 clones need 1,000 domains, ~$10,000/yr plus a 90-day wait, or aged ones bought at saffron prices, assume $30+ each. A fleet sharing one domain splits one payout.
